chunks: Muḥammad ibn al-Ḥasan ibn al-Walīd, from Muḥammad ibn al-Ḥasan al-Ṣaffār, from Aḥmad ibn Muḥammad, from Ibn Abī ʿUmayr, from Ḥammād, from al-Ḥalabī, who said:

Abū ʿAbdillāh عليه السلام was asked about a man who became junub during the month of Ramaḍān, then forgot to perform ghusl until the month of Ramaḍān had ended. He said: “He must make up the salat and the fasting.”

key_terms.أَجْنَبَ: entered the state of janabah (major ritual impurity)
key_terms.شَهْرِ رَمَضَانَ: the month of Ramaḍān, the time of obligatory fasting
key_terms.يَغْتَسِلَ: to perform ghusl, the ritual bath required for purification
key_terms.يَقْضِيَ: to make up missed obligatory acts later

ai.seo_question: What is the ruling if someone forgets to perform ghusl from janabah during Ramaḍān until the month ends?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling about one who remained in janabah during the month of Ramaḍān out of forgetfulness and did not perform ghusl until the month ended. Imam Abū ʿAbdillāh عليه السلام states that such a person must make up both the salat and the fasting.
